title: Read and edit a TTTR header
text: This tool reads the header of a TTTR file, lets you add or change its tags and saves a copy — the original file is never overwritten. Start with a demonstration file, then your own.

title: Start with a demonstration file
text: Load example writes a deterministic demonstration PTU in the settings cache and reads its header, so every control below has something to act on.

title: Pick a measurement
text: Pick a photon stream in the Input table to read its header -- the workspace's TTTR files (PTU / HT3 / SPC / HDF5) and the streams of .pto containers; files dropped on the ChiSurf window land there. Load example already added a deterministic demonstration PTU. The guide waits for your click; it does not choose or load a file for you.

await.hint: Pick a photon stream in the Input table.

title: Add a tag
text: Press Add to append a tag, then edit its name, type, value and index in the table. Invalid edits block saving.

await.hint: Press Add in the header tags panel.

title: Save a copy
text: Press Save as PTU to choose a destination after loading a source and checking the tags. The saved copy retains the original photon events; inspect the status for completion or errors.

await.hint: Press Save as PTU, then choose a new output file.
